title: Pager patterns & handoff scratch
body:
Weekly ops sync prep - quick personal scratchpad

Purpose / goal:
- Prep for weekly SRE ops sync + reliability readout. Keep it short: what tripped us, what’s burning the budget, what needs follow-up.
- Capture items to bring up with platform eng and oncall rotation.

Topline numbers (quick):
- Total pages last 7d: 27 (was 12 prev 7d) - spike on Wed early AM
- Priority 1 pages: 3 (2 were duplicate alerts for same incident)
- Error budget burn (service: text-gen): 6.4% last 7d (target monthly <10%)
- p95 latency trending +18% week-over-week, p99 spikes coincide with autoscaler events

Paging pattern notes (raw thoughts):
- Most pages: late-night 02:00-04:30 UTC (job overlap + autoscale churn). Need to verify scheduled jobs (batch export?)
- Duplicate alerts: alert dedupe not catching repeated K8s evictions vs downstream model OOMs. Suspect two alert rules reference same root cause.
- Noise source candidate: metrics exporter flapping on node reboots -> repeated service flapping alerts. Can we add 5m suppression window for node-restart flapping?

Recent top incidents (short):
1) 2026-08-05 03:12 UTC - model-serving OOM -> cascading 503s
   - Trigger: new config + increased batch size deployed in canary
   - Impact: ~12 min elevated 5xx, multi-tenant route degraded
   - Temp mitigation: rollback batch config, restart replica pool
   - Follow-up: test harness for batch-size load profiles (assign: Samir, due: 2026-08-13)

2) 2026-08-04 02:40 UTC - node autoscaler thrash -> pod evictions -> latency spike
   - Trigger: spike in short-lived inference bursts + autoscaler cooldown mis-tuned
   - Impact: p99 latency jump, ~8 pagers for downstream services
   - Follow-up: tweak scale-down cooldown, make autoscaler logs more visible in console (assign: Maya, due: 2026-08-11)

3) 2026-08-03 18:20 UTC - KV-cache eviction bug -> cache misses -> increased token cost
   - Trigger: race on shard rebalance
   - Impact: cost increase + small latency bump
   - Follow-up: add Canary that simulates rebalance with high key churn (assign: me, due: 2026-08-16)

SLOs and risk areas to mention:
- text-gen availability SLO: 99.7% monthly; current rolling month 99.73% (close, but watch error budget spend rate)
- embeddings SLO: stable, low burn, no action
- critical risk: autoscaler + scheduled batch overlap during low traffic windows -> repeated churn
- mitigation ask: request platform-eng to reserve a 'quiet window' for scale operations or adjust scheduled job timings

Agenda items for the sync (what I want to surface):
- Quick numbers + top 3 incidents (5 min)
- Autoscaler tuning plan proposal (10 min) - propose: increase scale-down grace from 2m to 6m; add cooldown jitter
- Alert review: dedupe rules + suppression windows (10 min) - propose: 5m suppression for node restart alerts; dedupe by root-cause tag
- Runbook gaps: model-serving OOM runbook needs clear rollback steps and canary gating (5 min)
- Action item ownership and dates (5 min)

Runbook / playbook quick notes (things to add/update):
- OOM incident play: immediate rollback + replica restart + disable auto-batching for canary traffic. Add checklist with single-command rollback link.
- Autoscaler play: how to force-stabilize cluster (drain + cordon pattern) and manual scale hooks.
- Paging postmortem template: add explicit duplicate-alert detection and steps to mark noise

Questions for 1:1 / manager follow-up:
- Can we get bandwidth to add a small synthetic that runs during suspected churn windows to reproduce autoscaler behavior? (ask platform-eng)
- Any appetite to delay non-critical nightly exports by 1 hour to reduce overlap with observed churn? (ops-cost tradeoff)
- Who owns the alert dedupe logic today? Ops or platform monitoring?

Action items I want on the board (personal):
- Draft autoscaler tuning RFC and share with platform-eng (Avery) - ETA 2026-08-11
- Add a canary test for batch-size change (Samir) - ETA 2026-08-13
- Implement simple 5m suppression on node-restart alert rule and monitor for 2 weeks (Maya) - ETA 2026-08-15
- Create postmortem skeleton for 2026-08-05 OOM (Avery) - start draft today, aim to have root-cause section by 2026-08-10

Notes to self / scratch bits:
- Slack threads to reference: #platform-autoscale (recent thread on 8/4), #model-serving (OOM thread 8/5)
- Might need to escalate to oncall manager if duplicate pages keep happening - metric: >20 duplicate pages/week -> escalate
- Keep the ops sync focused: 3 action items max for platform-eng this week

Misc quick checks before sync:
- confirm JIRA-1427 status (autoscaler tuning ticket) - link in linked artifacts
- fetch last 14d alert logs and prep 1 slide with hourly page counts (ask analytics)

End of scratchpad.

-- a.c.
